title: Local codimension-one ramification criterion for a finite flat morphism
statement: Let $X,Y$ be locally Noetherian schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $f:X\to Y$ be finite and flat [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $x\in X$ with $0<\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}$, where dimension is Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Suppose that for every $x'\in X$ specializing to $x$ with $\dim\mathcal O_{X,x'}=1$, there is an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq X$ of $x'$ such that $V\to Y$ is formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. Then there is an open neighbourhood $W\subseteq X$ of $x$ such that $W\to Y$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

proof.text: Positive local dimension means x is not the generic point of an irreducible component. Since f is finite it is quasi-finite. A supplied formally unramified neighbourhood at each dimension-one generalization expresses unramifiedness there. These are precisely the hypotheses of Stacks 0BJH, specialized to finite morphisms.

The proof of 0BJH works etale locally at x and f(x) so that x is the unique point above f(x). Etale localization (Stacks 02LK) preserves local dimensions and unramifiedness, and etaleness descends. A finite flat map over a locally Noetherian target is finite locally free. Its discriminant defines a locally principal closed branch locus on the target. If f(x) belongs to it, equality of source and target local dimensions (Stacks 00ON) and Stacks 0BJG give a dimension-one generalization y′ in that locus, even when the discriminant vanishes identically. Choose a ramified x′ above y′. Closedness of a finite map and uniqueness of the point in the original fibre force x′ to specialize to x. For a finite flat map the local dimensions at x′ and y′ agree. Thus x′ contradicts the dimension-one unramifiedness hypothesis. Therefore the map is etale at x. Openness of the etale locus supplies the asserted source neighbourhood. This is the complete discriminant argument of the cited source; its formalization is the remaining hole.

mathlib_searches.query: A finite flat morphism etale in codimension one with source boundary depth two is etale
A finite flat morphism of locally Noetherian schemes is etale at a nongeneric point if it is unramified at every dimension one generalization

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_neighbourhood_of_finite_flat_of_codimension_one
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Flat f] (x : X)
    (hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hunram : ∀ x' : X, Specializes x' x →
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x') = 1 →
      ∃ V : X.Opens, x' ∈ V ∧ FormallyUnramified (V.ι ≫ f)) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ Etale (V.ι ≫ f)
